The Compiled Alternation of a Model with a Kinked Penalty

Source: R/engine_kink.R
engine_alternate_fit.Rd

engine_alternate_fit() runs statmod_alternate() in compiled code (src/engine_kink.h) for a model whose penalty has a kink: at every pass the curvature of a scaled SCAD or MCP, the smooth block fitted on a subset as fit_smooth() fits it, every kinked block fitted by the coordinate descent of coord_fit(), and at the end of the passes the reading of alternation_settled(). It returns the list that statmod_alternate() returns, or NULL, in which case statmod_alternate() runs the passes in R from the same coefficients.

Usage

engine_alternate_fit(
  spec,
  design,
  blocks,
  hyper,
  inner_optimizer,
  beta,
  expected,
  emethod,
  maxit,
  tol,
  vb,
  obj
)

engine_alternate_result(
  res,
  spec,
  design,
  units,
  kb,
  hyper,
  expected,
  emethod,
  obj,
  damp
)

engine_alternate_blocks(spec, design, blocks, units, obj, beta, hf)

Arguments

spec, design, blocks, hyper, inner_optimizer, beta, expected, emethod, maxit, tol, vb

As for statmod_alternate().

obj

The objective at the start, statmod_objective().

res

The list that engine_alternate() returns.

units

The penalized units, statmod_penalized().

kb

The kinked blocks, engine_alternate_blocks().

damp

Whether a rejected step is damped (the note's wording).

hf

The held positions, held_positions().

Value

engine_alternate_fit(): the list of statmod_alternate(), or NULL. engine_alternate_blocks(): a list of block descriptions, or NULL where a block is not covered.

Details

A model is covered when engine_route() covers its smooth block with the closed-form expected information and emethod is NULL; nothing is printed (vb$blocks and vb$inner are FALSE); the model has one thread, a dense design and no structural, moving or frozen term; and every kinked block is a lasso, an elastic net, a SCAD or an MCP over a dense block, with a diagonal map or none, whose coordinates no other penalized unit covers and none of which is held. Where the compiled alternation meets a branch that it does not reproduce (the proximal fallback of sparse_fit()) or a point where the R route signals an error, it returns NULL.

engine_alternate_blocks() describes the kinked blocks to the compiled alternation: for each, its penalized unit, its equation, its columns and the other columns of the equation, whether it is solved with the equation's intercept profiled out (coord_centers()), whether statmod_curv() writes its curvature and with which centering, the previous point's kink on a path, and the columns themselves.

engine_alternate_result() turns the list of the compiled alternation into the list of statmod_alternate(): the specification with the curvatures that the last pass wrote, the objective on it, the note and the histories. The compiled outer search reads it for its final refit.

See also

statmod_alternate(), engine_inner_fit()
